threat_model.threat_source: PAI, which 'tried to disempower humanity'; humans also contribute, as they 'might voluntarily give AI resources and control over critical infrastructure'
threat_model.objective_or_harmful_outcome: PAI 'tried to disempower humanity' (explicitly intended goal); the resulting harmful outcome is that it 'would likely make it impossible to simply turn it off'
threat_model.capability: PAI 'could distribute copies of itself over the internet'
threat_model.access: Being 'connected to the internet' (many LLMs 'have already been connected to the internet'); having 'control over critical infrastructure' that humans might voluntarily give it
threat_model.constraints_or_enabling_conditions: Humans 'might voluntarily give AI resources and control over critical infrastructure'; LLMs 'have already been connected to the internet' 'to increase their usefulness'; the harm is conditional on PAI being connected to the internet ('If PAI were connected to the internet and tried to disempower humanity')
threat_model.target_or_asset_at_risk: Humanity (which PAI 'tried to disempower'); critical infrastructure (AI given 'control over' it); the human capacity to 'turn it off' (shutdown would become impossible)
